title: Project
description: Speth's Screens project file — single source of truth. Generated types: internal/project/types.go + packages/shared-types/src/project.ts

schemaVersion.description: Project file format. A file without it is format 1 and is upgraded when opened

pin.description: Operator PIN — operator panel locks behind this if set

viewOnly.description: Disable all write widgets in the operator panel

theme.description: The look of every screen: a preset, light or dark, and any element changed from the preset. A browser can still pick light or dark for itself; that choice is not saved in the project

security.description: Login settings. Missing means mode 'none'. Users live on the runtime (security.db), not in the project

scripts.description: Runtime scripts: JavaScript the runtime runs on its own (goja), on the triggers each one names

scriptRole.description: The role runtime scripts write as (roles and limits apply, and the audit names the script); missing means operator

languages.description: Language codes the screens can be shown in, such as en, de, es. The first is the language the project's text is written in; the operator screen offers a switch when there are two or more

translations.description: For each language, the project's text as written (page names, labels, alarm messages) mapped to its translation. A text with no entry shows as written

sessionVars.description: Variables kept per browser tab, read as {session:name}; they never reach the runtime

recipeSets.description: Recipe sets: one list of variables with many named recipes that operators can save, load and delete on the runtime

historian.description: What the historian stores and for how long. Missing means every change, plus one sample per tag every 60 s, kept for the runtime's --history-retention (default 7 days)

namespace.description: Unified Namespace — flat list of folders, assets and tags. Tags with driverId+driverAddr are bound to a live datasource

presets.description: Widget presets: set-up widgets saved for reuse. Inserting one copies its widgets onto a page with new ids; nothing links back to the preset. The runtime ignores presets.

enabledSymbolPacks.description: Symbol pack ids shown in the IDE symbol library. Missing means all packs

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: A preset sets every element; an element named here replaces the preset's choice, so a theme can be taken whole or built from its parts

accent.description: The main color of buttons and selections as #rrggbb; replaces the palette's

ThemePreset.title: ThemePreset
ThemePreset.description: calm: ISA-101 gray, flat, square corners, color only for abnormal states. clean: white cards, soft depth, round corners. modern: charcoal, soft corners, borders instead of shadows. Missing means calm

ThemeMode.title: ThemeMode
ThemeMode.description: Missing means the preset's own (light for calm and clean, dark for modern)

ThemePalette.title: ThemePalette
ThemePalette.description: The colors: calm is gray with a muted blue; modern is cool white or charcoal with a bright blue

ThemeCorners.title: ThemeCorners
ThemeCorners.description: Corner radius of cards and controls: 2, 6 or 12 px

ThemeDepth.title: ThemeDepth
ThemeDepth.description: flat: a 1 px border. raised: a soft shadow. borderless: neither, the cards stand out by color alone

ThemeDensity.title: ThemeDensity
ThemeDensity.description: Padding and text size. touch is larger, with controls at least 44 px tall, for tablets and panels

ThemeFont.title: ThemeFont
ThemeFont.description: The text font. All but system are bundled, so a PLC with no internet shows the same text

AuthMode.title: AuthMode
AuthMode.description: none: no login, anyone who reaches the runtime can read and write. login: every user must log in

DatasourceConfig.title: DatasourceConfig
DatasourceConfig.description: Driver-specific connection config. Fields used depend on 'type'.

certCheck.description: How the server's certificate is checked (https REST, ssl MQTT, OPC UA with security). Missing keeps the driver's old behavior: REST off, MQTT trusted, OPC UA off

certFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server certificate, for certCheck 'pinned' (hex, colons optional)

memoryTags.description: Memory datasource: the typed tags it holds

CertCheck.title: CertCheck
CertCheck.description: off: accept any certificate; pinned: only the one with certFingerprint; trusted: certificates the system trusts

CalculatedTag.title: CalculatedTag
CalculatedTag.description: A tag the virtual driver computes. Other expressions read it as {datasource:path}

path.description: The tag's name in this datasource

expr.description: Expression giving its value, e.g. clamp({mb:AI0} / 4095 * 100, 0, 100). A Bad or missing input makes the tag Bad

MemoryTag.title: MemoryTag
MemoryTag.description: A typed value the runtime holds; other expressions read it as {datasource:path}

path.description: The tag's name in this datasource

initial.description: The value before anything is written (and after a restart, unless retained); missing means false, 0 or empty text

retain.description: Keep the last value across a runtime restart

SessionVar.title: SessionVar
SessionVar.description: A typed value kept per browser tab, read as {session:name}

initial.description: The value when the tab opens; missing means false, 0 or empty text

ScriptTrigger.title: ScriptTrigger
ScriptTrigger.description: When a runtime script runs; it can name several

onChange.description: Tag paths (ds:path or ns:path): run when one changes

onStart.description: Run once when the project starts

onAlarm.description: Alarm rule ids: run when one raises or clears

RuntimeScript.title: RuntimeScript
RuntimeScript.description: JavaScript the runtime runs in its own sandbox, writing through the write pipeline as scriptRole, and only to the tags in its writes list

source.description: JavaScript (the script API: readTag, writeTag, onChange, every, after, log, emit, alarms)

writes.description: The tags the script may write: datasource:path, ns:path, or a prefix ending in * (mem:*, ns:Line1/*). A listed tag needs no widget; a script without the list writes nothing

backgroundColor.description: CSS color for the page background

icon.description: Shown beside the page's name in the navigation; missing shows the name's first letter

group.description: Pages with the same group are listed together under that heading in the sidebar

Shell.title: Shell
Shell.description: The frame around the pages in the operator screen

chrome.description: builtin (the default) draws the operator's own top bar and navigation; custom draws the frame slots instead

frame.description: With chrome custom: custom widgets pinned to the edges of every page, drawn around the page

FrameSlot.title: FrameSlot
FrameSlot.description: A custom widget pinned to an edge of the screen, with the page drawn in the room that is left. A smaller screen can move it to another edge or give it another size

params.description: Parameter name to binding, as on a custom widget placed on a page

size.description: Pixels high for a top or bottom edge, wide for a left or right edge

devices.description: Screen sizes it is drawn on; missing means all

FrameSlotOverride.title: FrameSlotOverride
FrameSlotOverride.description: What differs on a smaller screen; a phone inherits from the tablet and the tablet from the desktop

ShellNav.title: ShellNav
ShellNav.description: How a person moves between pages: a list on the left, a row of large icon buttons, or tabs. A phone always gets a bar along the bottom. Missing means tabs

toValue.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive). If set, matches value >= value && value < toValue. If missing, matches value >= value (open-ended, highest match wins)

style.description: line | step | area | dots | bars; missing means line

width.description: Pen width in pixels; missing means 1.5

dash.description: solid | dashed | dotted; missing means solid

axis.description: own | shared: shared pens use one Y scale (the first shared pen's); missing means own

expr.description: Expression (the Speth's Screens expression language): the alarm is active while it is true, e.g. {ns:Tank1/Level} > 95 && {ns:Tank1/InletOpen}. While an input it needs is Bad or missing, the alarm stays as it is

deadband.description: Default deadband in each tag's own units: a number is stored when it moves more than this from the last stored value. 0 stores any change. Text and true/false values ignore it

retentionDays.description: Days of history kept. Overrides the runtime's --history-retention

tags.description: Rules for single tags or groups; the most specific rule wins

path.description: Tag as datasource:path, e.g. 'plc1:Arp.Plc.Eclr/rTemp'. Ending in * matches every tag starting with the rest

deadband.description: Deadband for these tags; missing uses the default

store.description: false leaves these tags out of the history (default true)

RecipeSet.title: RecipeSet
RecipeSet.description: A fixed list of variables and the named recipes that set them. Operators can load, save, save as and delete recipes on the runtime; recipes made there are kept by the runtime, and a deploy adds the ones listed here without overwriting or restoring any an operator changed or deleted

variables.description: The variables every recipe of the set writes, in column order

recipes.description: The recipes shipped with the project

label.description: Column heading; missing shows the tag name

min.description: A saved or typed value below this is refused

max.description: A saved or typed value above this is refused

default.description: The value of a recipe that has none for this variable (a variable added after the recipe was saved); with no default the variable is left alone when the recipe is loaded

driverId.description: Datasource id the tag comes from

driverAddr.description: Raw driver address of the tag

widgets.description: Ordinary widgets; x and y are relative to the preset's top-left corner, ids are replaced on insert

layout.description: How the parts are placed; missing means free (each at its own x, y, w, h)

name.description: Used as {name} in bindings inside the custom widget

CustomWidgetLayout.title: CustomWidgetLayout
CustomWidgetLayout.description: How a custom widget places its parts. In a stack the parts follow each other in a row or a column and share the room by their flex settings; tablet and phone replace any field for that screen size

mode.description: free: each part at its own place; stack: parts follow each other

wrap.description: Parts that do not fit start a new line

CustomWidgetLayoutOverride.title: CustomWidgetLayoutOverride
CustomWidgetLayoutOverride.description: The stack settings that differ on a smaller screen; a phone inherits from the tablet and the tablet from the desktop

PartFlex.title: PartFlex
PartFlex.description: How a part takes room in a stack; a part with no flex keeps the size it has in the layout (w and h as grid units)

grow.description: Share of the free room; 0 keeps the part at its basis

basis.description: Size along the direction in pixels; 0 or missing fits the content

PartFlexOverride.title: PartFlexOverride
PartFlexOverride.description: What differs on a smaller screen; a phone inherits from the tablet and the tablet from the desktop

CanvasResolution.title: CanvasResolution
CanvasResolution.description: Screen size. 'dynamic' fills the browser window; 'fixed' uses width and height in pixels

FrameProps.title: FrameProps
FrameProps.description: Settings of the frame every widget is drawn in. Each widget type's settings include these

fontFamily.description: mono | sans | serif; empty means the theme font

fontSize.description: xs | sm | base | lg | xl | 2xl | 3xl | 4xl | 5xl | 6xl, or fit (the text grows to fill the card); empty means the widget's own size

fontPx.description: Exact text size in pixels; overrides fontSize

padding.description: Space inside the card in pixels; overrides noPadding and the theme

radius.description: Corner radius in pixels; missing means the theme's

borderWidth.description: Border width in pixels; missing means the theme's

shadow.description: false removes the card's shadow; missing means the theme's

showLabel.description: false hides the label above the value; missing means shown

showUnit.description: false hides the unit beside the value; missing means shown

valign.description: top | center | bottom: where the value sits in the card; missing means center

colorThresholds.description: Frame border color rules, applied to the color tag (bindings.color, else the value tag)

blinkPeriodMs.description: Blink period in milliseconds while dynamics.blink is on; missing means 800

blinkColor.description: Color the frame flashes while blinking; missing means the widget fades in and out

staticText.description: TextDisplay: fixed text shown instead of a tag value

autoscale.description: fit (follow the visible data) | nice (follow it, rounded to tidy numbers) | fixed (use min and max, or each pen's yMin and yMax); missing means fit when no limits are set, else fixed

showToolbar.description: Window, pause and history buttons; missing means shown

windows.description: Seconds of each window button; missing means 30, 60, 300 and 3600

live.description: false starts the trend paused; missing means running

fit.description: Image object-fit, as set by the properties panel

symbolId.description: Symbol: id from a symbol pack

motion.description: Symbol: what it does while animate is true

animate.description: Symbol: true while the symbol should move (a pump running); drive it from a tag

cycleSeconds.description: Symbol: seconds for one turn or one pulse; missing means 2

SymbolMotion.title: SymbolMotion
SymbolMotion.description: still: never moves. spin: turns round. pulse: fades in and out. A person who asks the browser for less motion sees it still

PageListProps.title: PageListProps
PageListProps.description: Settings of a page list widget: the project's pages as navigation, the open one highlighted

style.description: list: icon and name down the side, grouped; tabs: names in a row; icons: large icon buttons in a row; bar: icon over name, sharing the width

showGroups.description: list: show each page group's heading (default true)

ClockProps.title: ClockProps
ClockProps.description: Settings of a clock widget: the time in the operator's browser

format.description: What to show; missing means timeSeconds

DriverStatusProps.title: DriverStatusProps
DriverStatusProps.description: Settings of a driver status widget: whether each datasource is connected

compact.description: One summary (2/3) instead of a chip for each datasource

UserMenuProps.title: UserMenuProps
UserMenuProps.description: Settings of a user menu widget: who is signed in, and signing in or out

showName.description: Show the signed-in name beside the icon

RecipesProps.title: RecipesProps
RecipesProps.description: Settings of a recipes widget: the project's recipes, each with a button that writes its values

recipeSetId.description: The recipe set the table shows; missing shows the first set of the project

recipeId.description: Older projects: the recipe (shown as a set of its own) the widget shows

showEntries.description: Older projects: list the tags and values

PipeProps.title: PipeProps
PipeProps.description: Settings of a pipe widget: a line through points with an animated flow

points.description: Pipe: the corners as x,y pairs from 0 to 100 across the widget, e.g. "0,50 60,50 60,100"

weight.description: Pipe: line width in pixels; missing means 8

color.description: Pipe: the pipe's color, a CSS color or a token such as token:process-running

flow.description: Pipe: true while something flows; drive it from a tag

reverse.description: Pipe: flow runs from the last point to the first

flowColor.description: Pipe: the color of the moving dashes; missing means the theme's own

cycleSeconds.description: Pipe: seconds for the dashes to move one step; missing means 1

CustomWidgetProps.title: CustomWidgetProps
CustomWidgetProps.description: Settings of a custom widget placement

customWidgetId.description: Custom widget: id of the custom widget to show

TypedProps.title: TypedProps
TypedProps.description: Ties a widget's type to the settings type its props must follow

WidgetBindings.title: WidgetBindings
WidgetBindings.description: The tags a widget reads, by slot. Values are ds:path or ns:path (widgets inside a custom widget may use {param})

value.description: The tag the widget shows or writes

visible.description: BOOL tag: the widget is hidden while it is 0/false

color.description: Tag the frame's color thresholds read; missing means the value tag

Action.title: Action
Action.description: One thing a widget does when an event happens

tag.description: write, toggle, increment: the tag; missing means the widget's value tag

on.description: toggle: the value written when the tag is off; missing means 1 (true for a bool tag)

off.description: toggle: the value written when the tag is on; missing means 0 (false for a bool tag)

step.description: increment: the amount added; missing means 1

WidgetEvents.title: WidgetEvents
WidgetEvents.description: What a widget does when touched. onPress and onRelease write at once (momentary); onClick actions may be confirmed

Drive.title: Drive
Drive.description: Drives one property of a widget: the expression's value, through the transform if there is one. An unknown result, or a value of the wrong type for the property, leaves the property's own setting

expr.description: Expression (the Speth's Screens expression language); value is the widget's value tag

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description: Turns an expression value into a property value. linear: scale in to out; thresholds: the value of the last step whose above the value reaches; map: the value of the case it equals

clamp.description: linear: keep the result inside out; missing means true

steps.description: thresholds: steps in ascending order of above

below.description: thresholds: the value under the first step; missing leaves the property's own setting

cases.description: map: the cases, first match wins

default.description: map: the value when no case matches; missing leaves the property's own setting

TransformValue.title: TransformValue
TransformValue.description: A text, number or flag value (transform values, initial values)

locked.description: IDE-only: widget cannot be moved or resized

groupId.description: IDE-only: widgets with the same groupId move together

dynamics.description: Driven properties, by property name; which names a widget type has is listed in TypedProps

WidgetLayouts.title: WidgetLayouts
WidgetLayouts.description: Where the widget sits on a smaller screen. x, y, w and h above are the desktop layout; a tablet (under 1024 px wide) uses what is set here, and a phone (under 640 px) uses its own, then the tablet's, then the desktop's, one field at a time

WidgetPlacement.title: WidgetPlacement
WidgetPlacement.description: A widget's place on one screen size; a field left out is inherited from the next size up

hidden.description: Not shown on this screen size

CustomWidgetPart.title: CustomWidgetPart
CustomWidgetPart.description: A widget inside a custom widget. Same as Widget, but identified by localId, and it may say how it is laid out in a stack (flex, hiddenOn)

locked.description: IDE-only: widget cannot be moved or resized

groupId.description: IDE-only: widgets with the same groupId move together

hiddenOn.description: Screen sizes this part is left out of

dynamics.description: Driven properties, by property name; which names a widget type has is listed in TypedProps
